A '''weapons factory''' run by the [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was located in the [[Incorporation Islands]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]], the Drall [[Aerowynn]] led a number of Drall in resisting the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] invasion there.
